_doc: Product families: the top-level split of the catalog into separate, self-contained sub-catalogs. Every section belongs to exactly one family. Families are presentation + query scaffolding only; records keep their section memberships unchanged. Edit this file to move a section; the web app, MCP server, CLI and validate gate all read it.

families.name: Agent Memory
families.tagline: Shipping memory layers, memory features and memory products for AI agents.
families.audience: Builders choosing how their agent remembers.

families.name: Memory Research & Benchmarks
families.tagline: Papers, benchmarks and ideas behind agent memory, before they ship as products.
families.audience: Researchers and teams evaluating memory claims.
sections: Recent method papers — theorized, no distinct product
Theoretical / informal — ideas without a paper

families.name: Agent Frameworks & Harnesses
families.tagline: Frameworks, harnesses, IDEs and runtimes that agents are built and run in.

families.name: Retrieval & Data Infrastructure
families.tagline: Vector stores, knowledge graphs, embeddings and search that memory is built on.
families.audience: Builders picking storage and retrieval substrate.

families.name: Models, Serving & Ops
families.tagline: Foundation models, inference, training, evaluation and observability around agents.
